question: Which of the following sums up the central idea of the passage?

options.text: Jaisal Singh, the owner of SUJAN group of hotels has also been an important member of this traditional techniques associated with regional food cultures.

Given the large carbon foot-print and menace of fast-food businesses an attempt has been made to bring back our forefather's wisdom about eating to restore the connection of plate with people and planet.
Fast food businesses are at the root of large carbon foot-print. The possible solution lies only in eating home cooked food and stop eating out.

Annals about India's diversity have been writ on varied subjects from languages to cultures. However, the love for food and the ever-growing fast-food businesses has been the central subject of the interest.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Given the large carbon foot-print and menace of fast-food businesses an attempt has been made to bring back our forefather's wisdom about eating to restore the connection of plate with people and planet**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage highlights **India's love for food and its rich traditional and local edible biodiversity**.
 
• It also acknowledges that **food has a large carbon footprint** and that fast-food businesses are contributing to this problem.
 
• However, members of **Relais & Chateaux, in partnership with Slow Food International**, aim to **restore the connection of plate with people and the planet through the Slow Food Movement**.
 
• The **central idea **of the passage is** to bring back our forefather's wisdom about eating to restore the connection of plate with people and planet in the context of the large carbon footprint and the menace of fast-food businesses**.
 
• Thus, ***option 2*** is the correct answer.
